007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.profile;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.Profile;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.SelectAI;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.DbConnectionConfig;
012import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.GenerateAction;
013import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.GenerateParams;
014import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
015import org.slf4j.Logger;
016import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
017
018import java.util.Locale;
019
020/**
021 * Sample for calling {@link Profile#generate(String, GenerateAction, GenerateParams)}.
022 *
023 * <p>This sample demonstrates how to create a {@link SelectAI} client, open a
024 * {@link Profile}, build {@link GenerateParams} with an existing conversation
025 * identifier, call {@link Profile#generate(String, GenerateAction, GenerateParams)},
026 * and print the generated response.</p>
027 *
028 * <p>To run this sample with actions and prompts such as {@code showsql} and
029 * {@code how many customers}, ensure the profile object list contains tables
030 * that match the prompt. For example, if the profile object list references
031 * the Oracle sample schema objects {@code SH.CUSTOMERS} and {@code SH.COUNTRIES},
032 * ensure the {@code SH} schema is installed and visible to
033 * {@code SELECTAI_DB_USER}. The {@code SH} schema is not guaranteed to exist in
034 * every Oracle Autonomous AI Database or Oracle Database instance.</p>
035 *
036 * <p>Required environment variables:</p>
037 * <ul>
038 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_USER</li>
039 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD</li>
040 *   <li>SELECTAI_JDBC_URL</li>
041 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_NAME</li>
042 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_PROMPT</li>
043 *   <li>SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_ID</li>
044 * </ul>
045 *
046 * <p>Optional environment variables:</p>
047 * <ul>
048 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_GENERATE_ACTION - generation action. Defaults to {@code chat}.</li>
049 * </ul>
050 *
051 * <p>Example {@code SELECTAI_JDBC_URL}:</p>
052 * <pre>{@code
053 * jdbc:oracle:thin:@mydb_high?TNS_ADMIN=/path/to/wallet
054 * }</pre>
055 *
056 * <p>Before compiling or running this sample, build the SDK jar and copy runtime
057 * dependencies. Run the dependency copy command after {@code mvn clean install},
058 * because Maven {@code clean} removes the {@code target/} directory.</p>
059 * <pre>{@code
060 * mvn clean install
061 * mvn -Psamples -DincludeScope=runtime -DoutputDirectory=target/dependency dependency:copy-dependencies
062 * }</pre>
063 *
064 * <p>Compile this sample:</p>
065 * <pre>{@code
066 * javac --release 17 -cp "target/select-ai-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" \
067 *   -d samples/out \
068 *   samples/src/main/java/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/profile/GenerateWithGenerateParamsSample.java
069 * }</pre>
070 *
071 * <p>Run this sample:</p>
072 * <pre>{@code
073 * java -cp "samples/out:target/select-ai-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" \
074 *   com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.profile.GenerateWithGenerateParamsSample
075 * }</pre>
076 *
077 * <p>This sample prints normal result data to standard output so it is easy to
078 * read when run from a terminal. It uses the logger only for error reporting
079 * and diagnostics.</p>
080 */
081public final class GenerateWithGenerateParamsSample {
082    private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(GenerateWithGenerateParamsSample.class);
083
084    private GenerateWithGenerateParamsSample() {
085    }
086
087    public static void main(String[] args) {
088        String profileName = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_PROFILE_NAME");
089        String prompt = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_PROFILE_PROMPT");
090        String conversationId = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_ID");
091        GenerateAction action = GenerateAction.valueOf(
092                envOrDefault("SELECTAI_PROFILE_GENERATE_ACTION", "chat").trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT));
093
094        try {
095            Profile profile = createSelectAI().profile(profileName);
096            GenerateParams params = GenerateParams.builder().conversationId(conversationId).build();
097            String response = profile.generate(prompt, action, params);
098
099            System.out.printf("Generate action '%s' with params response:%n%s%n", action, valueOrEmpty(response));
100        } catch (SelectAIException e) {
101            LOGGER.error("Failed to generate response with params for Select AI profile '{}'.", profileName, e);
102        }
103    }
104
105    private static SelectAI createSelectAI() throws SelectAIException {
106        return SelectAI.create(DbConnectionConfig.builder()
107                .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
108                .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
109                .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
110                .build());
111    }
112
113    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
114        String value = System.getenv(name);
115        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
116            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
117        }
118        return value;
119    }
120
121    private static String envOrDefault(String name, String defaultValue) {
122        String value = System.getenv(name);
123        return value == null || value.isBlank() ? defaultValue : value;
124    }
125
126    private static String valueOrEmpty(String value) {
127        return value == null ? "" : value;
128    }
129}
